scope: Update progress, microphone recovery, and opening bookmarks.

topics.title: Web browser menu
details: The browser menu is now called Web browser menu. Say Web browser menu, or press Escape from a page, to return to it.
The guides, spoken Help, and lessons use the new menu name and update steps.

topics.title: Status during installation
details: A separate update window stays open while setup runs. Say Status or Update status to hear progress. You can also press its Status button or Enter.
The update window uses the app's offline speech files. You do not need to set up Windows speech to ask for progress.

topics.title: Voice commands after an update
details: Companion now opens with voice commands on after an update. You do not need to say Wake up again.
The update window lets go of the microphone first. Then Companion opens. If Windows keeps the device busy, the app tries again.

topics.title: Status while downloading
details: Status now stops the old progress speech and reads the current progress. You can keep asking while the file downloads or setup is being prepared.

topics.title: Opening bookmarks
details: Saved pages can open again after the browser closes. Browser problems leave you in the menu and keep your bookmarks saved.
If the chosen browser cannot start, Companion tries the included Firefox browser. Your saved browser choice stays the same.
An update closes the app's old browser before setup starts. This helps the browser open again after the update.
